allowed_claims: Moore and Dennard scaling are historically contingent engineering relationships.
Their breakdown does not prove a universal speed number.
forbidden_overreach: Atomic size alone sets all future computing speed.

allowed_claims: Quantum-speed limits constrain specified state transformations under specified resources.
forbidden_overreach: A QSL directly equals a whole-computer application throughput.

allowed_claims: Erasure heat, finite-time control, and finite signal propagation must be stated separately.
forbidden_overreach: Landauer's bound prices every operation identically.

allowed_claims: Quantum advantage and fault tolerance are workload- and architecture-dependent.
forbidden_overreach: Quantum computers have no physical processing-speed constraints.
